verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The 'Invites you to spend…' line is squeezed into a narrow column with one or two words per line, the dates are crammed in with odd breaks ('JUNE / 8-24'), the cross is upscaled into a blurry blob, and the illustration sits in a hard-edged box that looks pasted on. A is slightly worse: its larger cross nearly touches the illustration and its invite column is jammed against the headline. B has a little more breathing room between the columns.
